prose: Data-center shares fell as investors expect a slower AI buildout after Democratic election wins: Hut 8 dropped 23%, IREN 11%, Core Scientific 10% and Applied Digital 7%, per Reuters, even as Wall Street closed sharply higher on reduced political uncertainty.
highlights: Hut 8 -23%, IREN -11%, Core Scientific -10%, Applied Digital -7%
Broad market closed sharply higher; data-center names diverged
